source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
[Inflamed Reprisal](vsdata:ability/death-guard.mortarion.inflamed-reprisal) on Mortarion is rewritten. In your opponent's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), if an enemy attack targets a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours no more than 6" from Mortarion, Mortarion may use this ability to let that **DEATH GUARD** unit shoot after the attacker's attacks are all resolved, using the rules for your own Shooting phase, but:

- its attacks have their **BS** worsened by 1
- it can only target the attacking unit, and only if that unit is an eligible target

typedMechanics.recipient: one Death Guard unit targeted by the enemy attack
typedMechanics.reaction: recipient shoots as in own Shooting phase
